blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The camp of Vice President Sara Duterte will no longer present a Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) official as a witness before the Senate Impeachment Court, defense team spokesperson Michael Poa said on Thursday. Poa informed the court that the defense had dispensed with the testimony of BPI senior vice president Atty. Paul Roderick Ysmael. READ: VP Duterte’s camp calls off presentation of 15 bank execs as witnesses On Wednesday, Poa said the defense had also dispensed with the testimony of 15 other bank officials. /mcm...
